map.象棋残局提示器，提供一步杀、两步杀与经典江湖残局解法参考，辅助象棋爱好者研习杀法: The Xiangqi endgame hint tool provides one-move and two-move mates and classic Jianghu endgame solutions, aiding enthusiasts in studying mating patterns.
map.一步杀/两步杀图解：给定局面给出最短杀着与后续解将步骤。: One/two-move mate diagrams: given a position, give the shortest mating move and subsequent check-escapes.
map.经典江湖残局：如「七星聚会」「千里独行」等名局研究，体会精确着法。: Classic Jianghu endgames: study famous positions like "Qixing Juhui" and "Qianli Duxing" to appreciate precise moves.
map.常见杀法演示：马后炮、重炮、闷宫、双车错、卧槽马等 8 种杀法逐一演示。: Common mating-pattern demos: horse-behind-cannon, double-cannon, smothered, double-chariot, horse-to-corner, etc.—8 patterns demonstrated one by one.
map.：输入某残局，工具展示马控将门、炮借马威将军的着法序列，输出「马八进七—炮九平四: : Input an endgame; the tool shows the move sequence where the horse controls the general's gate and the cannon mates via the horse's power, outputs steps like "horse 8 to 7—cannon 9 to 4" and judges a one-move mate, reminding to watch the opponent's blocking move.
map.一步杀怎么判定？: How is a one-move mate judged?
map.从将军着法倒推，确认对方无论怎么解将（垫将/避将/吃子）均无效，即一步杀。: Work backward from the checking move; confirm the opponent's every response (block/evade/capture) fails—that's a one-move mate.
map.子力少、陷阱多、和棋率高，常需精确着法，误着即败或和，适合练算度。: Few pieces, many traps, high draw rate; precise moves required—a wrong move loses or draws; good for calculation training.
map.常见杀法有哪些？: What common mating patterns are there?
map.马后炮、重炮、闷宫、双车错、卧槽马、挂角马、铁门栓、天地炮等，多为车马炮协同成杀: Horse-behind-cannon, double-cannon, smothered, double-chariot, horse-to-corner, horse-to-angle, iron-gate, heaven-earth-cannon, etc.—mostly chariot/horse/cannon coordination to mate.
